note: Landforms around the playable town, from the beauty corner's horizon (scenes/lookdev/beauty_corner.gd). Metres, town coordinates (origin = town centre, floor y = 0). Each sits on the terrain at its x, z. keep_out_margin = no boulders this close to the town's floor area. planet_mesas are [latitude degrees, longitude degrees, radius, height] for the 5 km-radius home world; they replace the local mesa list on a spherical planet. Spires (the tall skinny rocks, called hoodoos in the code): three variations of one wind-cut sandstone spire, reused everywhere, each a broad flared skirt, a lumpy lower body of stacked bulges, a long tapering finger split by vertical cracks and a rounded top. spire_variants: height and radius (the skirt's, at the foot) in metres, lean = [x, z] metres the top sits off the foot, seed for its noise, bands = bulges up the body, bulge = how far they stand out (fraction of the radius), cracks = vertical cracks and crack_depth, twist = radians the lobes turn from foot to top. spire_profile = [height fraction, radius fraction] shared by all three. spire_column = a ship's column radius as a fraction of the skirt's. spire_strata = the rock shader's strata scale. hoodoos are [x, z, variant, yaw degrees]: the five rock towers the Hoodoo Run race course weaves round (issue #610, content/core/racing/courses/hoodoo_run.json), placed by hand beside its racing line. planet_hoodoos are [latitude, longitude, variant, yaw] all round the ball, clear of the town, outposts, wrecks, camps, courses and mesas (flat worlds have only the race towers). short_hoodoos are the original hoodoos (a fluted column under a cap stone), cut to half their old height for a mix of short old rocks and tall new spires: [latitude, longitude, radius, height] all round the ball, clear of everything above. boulders: on the ball (planet_wide) the same count is spread round the whole planet, near_rocks of them in fields at the feet of the mesas and spires (out to near_reach of the rock's radius past its foot) and the rest anywhere; a flat world keeps the ring min_dist..min_dist + spread round the town.
